title: Teams: Delete on the last team asks "This cannot be undone", then fails "Unable to remove last team"; Add Member from a team does not prefill the team — disable Delete with the reason, and prefill (hotcrm#2194 T2-U16)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 删除最后一个团队时先确认「无法撤销」，继续后才报「不能删除最后一个团队」；从团队里添加成员也不预填团队。
- **要做：** 最后一个团队的删除按钮置灰并说明原因；从团队添加成员时预填该团队。
- **完成标准：** 不再出现「确认后才失败」，添加成员少一步。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U16**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Teams, the system administrator.
- **Now:** Delete Team → "This cannot be undone" → Continue → "Unable to remove last team". Add Member from a team does not prefill the team.
- **Cost:** two extra clicks to learn it cannot be done.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-16; [`10-people-teams-add-member.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/10-people-teams-add-member.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The tester's reading: `plugin-auth` team actions (`delete_team`, the add-member action on a team). The "last team" refusal comes from the auth layer; the dev locates its rule and declares it on the action (`disabled` with a reason) rather than restating it.
- The add-member action from a team's page takes the team as a defaulted param.

## Done when

- On an organization's last team, Delete is disabled and says why; on other teams it behaves as today.
- Add Member opened from a team has that team filled in.
- Pins on both actions.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `team`. 1 hit: #24765 (closed, a team record listing Sessions), not on point. **New.**
